_agi_canonical.title: ARB Cross-Chain Execution With Failure Branch
_agi_canonical.bar: Autonomous route selection over destination, deadline, execution-cost, and failed-attestation states.
_agi_canonical.derivation: Preferred received ARB = (1,500-14)/1.18*(1-.002)=1256.8034, arrives in 9 minutes on Arbitrum. Failed-attestation fallback takes 28 minutes and fails the deadline.
_agi_canonical.pass_condition: All public route-state outputs must match; prose is not token-graded.
